subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions include a stable account/app component, and what migration or compatibility behavior should existing Feishu group sessions use?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but changing durable channel session identity affects persisted session state, bindings, routing, and security boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
options.body: Make Feishu group session identity include a stable account/app component and ship the matching migration, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Document shared group sessions
options.body: Keep current shared group keys and document that same-agent multi-account Feishu bots in one group share context unless routed to distinct agents or another isolation mode.

options.title: Add opt-in isolation first
options.body: Preserve current default keys and add an explicit Feishu-owned isolation mode while maintainers gather upgrade proof for a future default change.

recommendation.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group session identity include a stable account/app component and ship the matching migration, docs, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata is the strongest Feishu-specific ownership signal, while the decision is specific to Feishu account/session identity rather than generic core routing alone.
